children: NEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / October 21, 2026 /
Emerging Growth Research ("Emerging Growth Research" or "EGR") today announced the release of its company-sponsored research Flash Report on First Phosphate Corp.
, a mineral development and clean technology company building a vertically integrated North American supply chain for lithium iron phosphate ("LFP") battery materials.

The Flash Report reviews a series of milestones achieved over the past four months that have advanced First Phosphate's Bégin-Lamarche igneous phosphate project in Quebec and strengthened its development outlook.
Key Highlights
Over the past four months, First Phosphate has:
1) secured formal G7 endorsement, positioning the project as a strategic asset in the development of a Western LFP phosphate supply chain;
2) obtained fast-track permitting status from Quebec, potentially accelerating regulatory approvals;
3) secured C$4.9 million in non-repayable federal funding for road and electrical infrastructure;
4) completed a Nasdaq listing (PHOS), expanding access to U.S. institutional investors;
5) increased Indicated mineral resources by 378% through an updated Mineral Resource Estimate;
6) expanded its shareholder base nearly 10x, from 1,301 to 12,501 investors in one year;
7) received a Letter of Support from Swiss Export Risk Insurance (SERV) for a potential guarantee of up to US$212.5 million in project capital expenditures;
8) gained independent scientific validation through a peer-reviewed study supporting the deposit's world-class potential; and
9) established over two years of funding runway.

The Flash Report notes that these milestones reduce geological, regulatory and financing risks and support a less dilutive path toward construction. The Company is targeting completion of its feasibility study in Q1 2027 and a Final Investment Decision in Q1/Q2 2028.

About First Phosphate Corp.
First Phosphate Corp.

is a mineral exploration and development and clean technology company dedicated to building and reshoring a vertically integrated mine-to-market supply chain for the production of LFP batteries in North America. Target markets include energy storage, data centers, robotics, mobility, and national security. First Phosphate's flagship Begin-Lamarche property, located in Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean, Quebec, Canada, represents a rare North American igneous phosphate resource producing high-purity phosphate characterized by very low levels of impurities. For more information, please visit www.FirstPhosphate.com.
